name: reward-bench-log-probs
description: A dataset intended to evaluate reward-model signals by providing log-probabilities for model responses, enabling assessment of how well log-prob-based scores correlate with human or reference rewards. It is used to study ranking, calibration, and alignment of models using likelihood signals.
general_score_metric: Spearman correlation between log-prob scores and reference rewards
reputation: A niche resource primarily of interest to researchers working on reward modeling and alignment; limited mainstream adoption.
